questions.prompt: The session has 11 events for the notes.txt turn. Why does messagesFrom return only 4 messages?
options: Only user, assistant and tool result events become messages; markers and tool/call are skipped
The function drops the oldest events to save tokens
Each message joins exactly three events
Tool results are not sent to the model
questions.explanation: Events 2, 3, 5 and 8 are messages the model must see. The turn and step markers and the tool/call record stay in the session only.

questions.prompt: A tool result event is followed by a user/message with the time. What does add do with them?
options: It keeps them as two separate user messages
It drops the time because it came second
It joins them into one user message so the roles still alternate
It turns the time into an assistant message
questions.explanation: add joins two messages in a row with the same role. Both are user messages, so they become one, and the roles stay user, assistant, user.

questions.prompt: Why is it safe that the message list is never stored?
options: Because the model remembers the earlier messages
Because it can be rebuilt from the session at any time, so it can never disagree with the record
Because the session file stores the list for you
Because messages never change during a turn
questions.explanation: A projection is computed from the record by a fixed rule. The same events always give the same messages, so there is no second copy to drift.
